focus_areas: Bill coloration saturation vs. breeding standards
Totipalmate foot structure verification via segmentation
Spatial grounding of subject before boundary audit
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the coloration of the bill; the checkpoint required 'bright' colors which are absent. Determine if this is a species variation (non-breeding) or a generation error using the perceptual auditor's color analysis. Scrutinize the connection point between the webbed feet and the rock surface for any signs of melting, and use the topology auditor to confirm all four toes are actually connected (totipalmate) rather than just appearing so from a distance.
image_description: A large pelican standing on a rocky, grassy outcrop against a clear blue sky. The bird has white plumage on its body and neck, with dark grey/black flight feathers on the wings. It features a long, pale bill with a visible gular pouch and short, dark webbed feet.
